remarks: Experience modern city living in this well-maintained condo located on the 11th floor in the heart of Downtown Stamford. This spacious unit features a large open floor plan with breathtaking sunrises and expansive city views. The kitchen includes stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and a breakfast bar perfect for entertaining. The living/dining area features hardwood flooring and wall-to-wall windows, allowing for plenty of natural light. Retreat to the spacious bedroom, complete with a walk-in closet and direct access to the double-entry bathroom featuring tasteful renovations. The Biltmore, a luxury high-rise in the heart of Downtown Stamford, offers 24-hour concierge, fitness center, shuttle to the train, community room, laundry room, storage, 4th floor courtyard, dry cleaning services and is pet-friendly. Secure garage parking is available for $115 per month per car. Conveniently located near i95, Metro-North, Merritt Parkway, and just steps away from the famous Bedford Street. Experience city living at its best with this turnkey opportunity in the heart of Stamford!
